title: A single-minded focus on commerce education
paragraphs: CPE Educational Institutions began in 2007 with a clear purpose — to give students in Visakhapatnam a serious, well-taught pathway into commerce and professional qualifications. CPE Junior College carries that purpose forward at the intermediate level.

We deliberately keep our scope narrow. By teaching only MEC and CEC, and by running CA, CMA, IPMAT and CLAT preparation inside the college itself, our faculty and infrastructure stay concentrated on what our students actually need.
The college is located at 10-5-7, Sri Sai Surya Building, Ram Nagar, Visakhapatnam, and follows the academic calendar and curriculum of the Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh.
